signals.title: Ruring'u Housing Project Opens Pathways From Tvet Training to Employment
signals.summary: [Capital FM] Nairobi -- The Ruring'u Affordable Housing Project is providing a practical link between technical training and employment, giving young TVET graduates an opportunity to apply classroom skills on an active construction site while gaining experience demanded by the industry.

signals.title: Capitalpay Targets Costly Payment Gaps Slowing African Trade
signals.summary: [Capital FM] Nairobi -- Garang Mayom Malek is building CapitalPay International around a part of financial technology that consumers rarely see, where payments must be matched with invoices, licences, cargo records, professional services and institutional approvals before transactions can be completed.

signals.title: Leather Producers Seek Duty Relief On Raw Materials
signals.summary: [Ghanaian Times] KUMASI -- The Ghana Leather and Footwear Manufacturers Association (GLFMA) has petitioned Parliament for urgent policy intervention and customs duty relief under Chapter 98 for raw materials used in the local leather and footwear industry.

signals.title: Three Arrested in 'Bolle Jos' Drug Case
signals.summary: [Ghanaian Times] The Narcotics Control Commission (NACOC) has arrested three persons over their alleged involvement in the activities of Dutch fugitive Jos Leidekkers, popularly known as "Bolle Jos", in Ghana.

signals.title: Telecel Foundation Offers Free Health Screening At Fetu Afahye
signals.summary: [Ghanaian Times] The Telecel Ghana Foundation has provided free health screening to residents of Abura in the Central Region as part of this year's Fetu Afahye celebrations.

signals.title: GCAA, Jarus Partner to Strengthen Drone Safety, Regulation
signals.summary: [Ghanaian Times] The Ghana Civil Aviation Authority (GCAA) has partnered with the Joint Authorities for Rulemaking on Unmanned Systems (JARUS) to strengthen the safe, secure and orderly operation of unmanned aircraft systems (drones) in Ghana and across jurisdictions.

signals.title: Intensify Public Education On Cannabis, Indian Hemp - Traditional Medicinal Practitioner
signals.summary: [Ghanaian Times] A traditional medical practitioner, Dr Christiana Torvor, has called for intensified public education on cannabis and industrial hemp to address misconceptions and stigma surrounding their use.

signals.title: Yemi Alade Releases Highly Anticipated Self-Titled Album
signals.summary: [Capital FM] Global Afro-pop superstar Yemi Alade has released her highly anticipated self-titled studio album, 'IT'S YEMI ALADE' - a celebration of her identity, heritage and the ever-evolving sound of Africa.

signals.title: Mozambique and EU Deepen Cooperation in Security and Defense
signals.summary: [AIM] Maputo -- The European Union (EU) and Mozambique have decided to deepen their cooperation in the fields of security and defense, with a particular focus on combating terrorism in the northern province of Cabo Delgado.

signals.title: Stanbic Bank Confirms Michael Mutiga As CEO
signals.summary: [Capital FM] Nairobi -- Stanbic Bank Kenya has confirmed Michael Mutiga as its Chief Executive Officer (CEO) following approval by the Central Bank of Kenya.

signals.title: Babiito Reject Attorney General's Advice On Tooro Succession
signals.summary: [Independent (Kampala)] Fort Portal -- The Babiito royal clan of Tooro Kingdom has rejected the Attorney General's advice that the late Omukama Oyo Nyimba Kabamba Iguru Rukidi IV's purported will should guide the succession process, saying the legal opinion was addressed to President Yoweri Kaguta Museveni and does not direct the clan to take any action.

signals.title: Housing Finance Bank Deepens Hoima Presence As Bunyoro Economy Expands
signals.summary: [Independent (Kampala)] Hoima -- Housing Finance Bank (HFB) is strengthening its presence in Hoima as growing economic activity in Bunyoro creates new demand for housing, agricultural, micro-business and small and medium enterprise financing.

signals.title: Ouganda : dernier hommage au roi Oyo sur fond de crise de succession
signals.summary: Le royaume de de Tooro fondé il y a deux siècles peine à s'entendre sur le nom de son prochain monarque. Edward Rukidi Nyabongo Ier est déjà contesté.

signals.title: Kephic 2026 to Focus On Disease Prevention and Climate Health Risks
signals.summary: [Capital FM] Nairobi -- Kenya will host the Kenya Public Health International Conference, KEPHIC 2026, from October 27 to 29 at the Kenyatta International Convention Centre in Nairobi.

signals.title: Crise au Yémen : plus de 2 000 déplacés accueillis à Djibouti
signals.summary: La récente escalade a mis fin à un cessez-le-feu qui avait largement stoppé la guerre civile à travers le Yémen depuis 2022.

signals.title: Nigeria : la raffinerie Dangote ouvre son capital au public [Africanews Today]

signals.title: Kenya : l’opposant Edwin Sifuna veut capitaliser sur la colère de la "Gen Z"
signals.summary: À moins d’un an de la présidentielle kényane de 2027, le sénateur Edwin Sifuna s’impose progressivement comme l’un des visages les plus en vue de l’opposition.

signals.title: Côte d'Ivoire : le Biama, bien plus qu'une danse, un mouvement
signals.summary: À Yopougon, quartier d'Abidjan où tout a commencé, des « biamasseurs » organisent des événements en plein air où les DJ et danseurs se succèdent sur scène.

signals.title: Bolt, Yango, Gozem… Qui saura profiter du retrait progressif d’Uber en Afrique ?
signals.summary: Côte d’Ivoire, Tanzanie, Nigeria, Ouganda… Le géant américain des voitures de transport avec chauffeur (VTC) réduit progressivement sa présence sur le continent, ouvrant la voie à une multitude d’opérateurs aux stratégies d’acquisition aussi agressives que diverses.

signals.title: Bandits Once Collected Bride Prices, Imposed Taxes in Kaduna - State Govt
signals.summary: [Leadership] Kaduna State government has hinted that bandits once controlled rural communities, imposing taxes, dictating farming activities and even collecting bride prices.

signals.title: Govt Targets 200 Towers By December As 3,700-Tower Rollout Begins - Tijani
signals.summary: [Vanguard] Minister of Communications, Innovation and Digital Economy, Dr Bosun Tijani, has said the Federal Government will activate at least 200 telecommunications towers by December as part of its project to deploy 3,700 towers across the country,

signals.title: Yémen : près de 94 000 personnes fuient les combats, dont 2 000 vers Djibouti
signals.summary: Près de 94 000 personnes avaient fui leur foyer au Yémen depuis que les combats entre les rebelles houthis et les forces gouvernementales se sont intensifiés ce mois-ci. Plus de 2 000 personnes ont fui par la mer vers Djibouti.

signals.title: Madagascar: l’État veut reprendre la main sur les importations d’hydrocarbures
signals.summary: À Madagascar, les quatre principaux distributeurs de carburant ne sont plus les seuls à gérer l'achat et l'importation de produits pétroliers. Depuis un mois, la State Procurement of Madagascar (SPM), assure également l'approvisionnement en pétrole de la Grande Île. Une loi entrée en vigueur début août prévoit même qu'elle devienne la seule entité responsable de l'importation d'hydrocarbures à l'issue d’une période transitoire dont la durée n'a pas été communiquée.

signals.title: Women Account for 9.7% of National Assembly, 11.1% of Presidential Candidates - INEC
signals.summary: [Daily Trust] Women remain significantly underrepresented in the 2027 elections, accounting for only 9.7 per cent of the candidates contesting the National Assembly seats and 11.1 per cent of those seeking the presidency, an analysis of the final list published by the Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) has shown.

signals.title: No More White Elephants Projects - Tinubu
signals.summary: [Daily Trust] President Bola Tinubu has warned Nigeria's Regional Development Commissions against wasting public funds on poorly conceived projects, declaring that the era of costly "white elephant" schemes with little benefit to citizens is over.

signals.title: Disparition du journaliste Moussa Kaka au Niger: «Le Sahel ne doit pas devenir un trou noir de l'information»
signals.summary: Au Niger, deux semaines après sa disparition, on est toujours sans nouvelles de notre confrère Moussa Kaka. Mais aujourd'hui, Reporters sans frontières (RSF) parle de « disparition forcée » et dit avoir de bonnes raisons de penser que les autorités militaires de Niamey y sont pour quelque chose. signals.title: Govt Did Not Approve Market Near School - Stan Dogbe Clears Air On Ahafo Ano South Market Siting
signals.summary: [Ghanaian Times] Deputy Chief of Staff, Stan Xoese Dogbe has reacted to a viral video raising concerns about the siting of a market close to a school in the Ahafo Ano South District of the Ashanti Region.

signals.title: Security Tightened At Luweero High Court Ahead of Election Petition Hearings
signals.summary: [Nile Post] Security has been heightened at Luweero High Court ahead of the hearing of election petitions filed by candidates who lost in the January 2026 parliamentary elections and are challenging results declared by the Electoral Commission.

signals.title: Germany, Denmark Reaffirm Cultural and Green Ties With Ethiopia
signals.summary: [ENA] Addis Ababa -- Germany and Denmark have emphasized cultural diplomacy, people to people exchanges, academic cooperation and green transformation as key pillars of their longstanding partnerships with Ethiopia.

signals.title: BRICS Summit Backs Ethiopia's Global Diplomatic, Economic Agenda
signals.summary: [ENA] Addis Ababa -- Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed participated in the second and final day of the 18th BRICS Leaders' Summit in New Delhi on September 13, as leaders of the bloc member countries concluded two days of high-level deliberations with the adoption of the New Delhi Declaration.

signals.title: General Muhoozi Reinstates Uganda's Participation in 2027 Invictus Games
signals.summary: [Nile Post] Chief of Defence Forces (CDF) Gen Muhoozi Kainerugaba has reinstated Uganda's participation in the 2027 Invictus Games in Birmingham, United Kingdom, following clarification from Buckingham Palace on the position of King Charles III.

signals.title: Ghanaian Ambassador to Angola Gives Positive Assessment of Bilateral Relations
signals.summary: [ANGOP] Luanda -- President João Lourenço on Monday received Ghana's outgoing ambassador to Angola, Mavis Esi Kusorgbor, who gave a positive assessment of relations between the two countries.

signals.title: Projecting Rule of Law, Retaining Autocratic Roots - Democracy-Speak in Ethiopia's National Dialogue
signals.summary: [Addis Standard] Addis Abeba -- Ethiopians went to the polls in June 2026. Six weeks later, the National Dialogue Commission opened its national conference, the culminating stage of the state-led process formally established in 2021. It invited the public to engage with the rules of  political coexistence just as another election had confirmed the incumbent's overwhelming dominance. Through both moments, discussions were framed in a familiar language of deepening and…

signals.title: Govt to Support Raila Family in Anniversary Preparations - Ruto
signals.summary: [Capital FM] Nairobi -- President William Ruto has said the Government is working closely with the family of the late former Prime Minister Raila Odinga to organise the anniversary of his death.

signals.title: Ruto Defends Housing Levy, Says Azimio and Kenya Kwanza Manifestos Proposed It
signals.summary: [Capital FM] Kisumu -- President William Ruto has defended the housing levy, saying both the Azimio la Umoja and Kenya Kwanza political coalitions proposed the introduction of a levy in their election manifestos.

signals.title: Starvation or Shelling - Dwindling Aid in Uganda Forces Sudanese Refugees Back to the Battlefield
signals.summary: [Ayin Network] From the Al-Manshiya neighbourhood in eastern Khartoum, the Sudanese capital, to a refugee camp in northern Uganda, Ali Ishaq Idris, 22, faced a series of challenges. While fleeing the war in Khartoum, a stray bullet hit him in the leg, forcing him to walk on crutches while displaced in the hilly, rural Kiryandongo Refugee Camp in Uganda. Despite this, Ali Shaq is considering returning to Khartoum given the lack of food in the camp.

signals.title: Court Rules Retired Presidents Cannot Hold Political Party Office Beyond Six Months
signals.summary: [Capital FM] Nairobi -- The High Court has upheld a law restricting retired presidents from holding office in political parties beyond six months after leaving the presidency.

signals.title: Wetang'ula Urges MPs to Advance Kenya's Interests At Commonwealth Conference
signals.summary: [Capital FM] Nairobi -- National Assembly Speaker Moses Wetang'ula has challenged Kenyan MPs attending the 69th Commonwealth Parliamentary Conference in Cape Town, South Africa, to use the forum to advance the country's interests while sharing Kenya's parliamentary experience with other Commonwealth states.

signals.title: Ruto Says Kenya Has No Room for Leaders Promoting Chaos and Violence
signals.summary: [Capital FM] Kisumu -- President William Ruto has warned political leaders against using chaos, violence and divisive politics to advance their interests, saying Kenya has no room for leaders bent on destabilising the country.

signals.title: Nollywood Film 'Black Market' Targets Guinness World Record With Lagos Screening
signals.summary: [Leadership] Nollywood film Black Market is attempting to set a new Guinness World Record for the largest single-location film screening at Tafawa Balewa Square (TBS) in Lagos on September 26, 2026.

signals.title: 4,765 Out of 7,961 Flights Operated in August Delayed - Report
signals.summary: [Daily Trust] No fewer than 4,765 out of 7,961 domestic flights operated by Nigerian airlines in August 2026 were delayed, representing about 60 per cent of total flights, according to the Nigeria Civil Aviation Authority (NCAA).

signals.title: Ghana's Local Architecture Has Adapted to Change for Centuries. It Can Teach Us About Climate Resilience
signals.summary: [The Conversation Africa] When people discuss architecture in Ghana, attention often focuses on modern buildings: concrete houses, glass offices, shopping malls and ambitious urban developments. Yet across the country, another architectural tradition continues to offer lessons about how people have built and lived for generations.

signals.title: Kenya: Can Ruto turn the Tata Chemicals row into votes in 2027?
signals.summary: William Ruto has stormed into a century-old dispute over Maasai land and Tata Chemicals’ operations in Kajiado. With jobs and water supplies already hit by the shutdown, can taking on the Indian-owned company help the Kenyan president at the ballot box next year?

signals.title: Mali: à Bamako, le Premier ministre algérien plaide pour un renforcement des relations entre les deux pays
signals.summary: Dans la foulée de la visite du Premier ministre malien Abdoulaye Maïga à Alger le 24 août dernier, son homologue algérien Sifi Ghrieb s'est rendu à Bamako, lundi 14 septembre. Un déplacement dont l'objectif était d'entériner le réchauffement des relations entre les deux capitales après plusieurs mois de tensions.

signals.summary: Le Premier ministre algérien Sifi Ghrieb est arrivé lundi à Bamako pour une visite visant à consolider le rapprochement entre l'Algérie et le Mali, après plus d'un an de fortes tensions diplomatiques entre les deux voisins sahéliens. Cette visite intervient trois semaines après celle effectuée le 24 août par Abdoulaye Maïga à Alger. La Commission de l’Union économique et monétaire ouest-africaine (UEMOA) a ouvert, ce lundi à Ouagadougou, au Burkina Faso, une session d’information et de sensibilisation destinée aux professionnels des médias des huit États membres. signals.title: Kenya : des crocodiles deplacés parce qu'ils menacent les habitants
signals.summary: Au Kenya, la forte concentration de crocodiles dans le lac Baringo représente une menace croissante pour les populations riveraines. Pour réduire les risques, les agents de la faune kényane capturent certains de ces reptiles avant de les transférer vers d’autres lacs du pays.

signals.title: Niger : en écartant le général Barmou, Abdourahamane Tiani veut reprendre la main sur l’armée
signals.summary: Quelques semaines après la mutinerie d’une partie des forces spéciales, les 28 et 29 août, le chef de la junte nigérienne a procédé à un vaste remaniement de la hiérarchie militaire. Un premier signal de la réponse du pouvoir à la mutinerie qui a secoué Niamey.

signals.title: Sénégal : face à Starlink, Sonatel pousse l’État à faire respecter les règles
signals.summary: Le 7 septembre, la Cour suprême du Sénégal a suspendu Starlink après un recours déposé par Sonatel. L’opérateur historique dénonce des irrégularités dans l’attribution de la licence de la filiale d’Elon Musk et appelle l’État mettre à jour la régulation de ce type d’acteur.

signals.summary: [allAfrica] Mali built a cotton sector capable of producing, ginning and exporting at scale. Mossadeck Bally argues that this success must now support a more demanding ambition: retain more fibre, begin with spinning and finance industry for the long term.

signals.title: "Je suis un Lion, j'ai peur de rien" : les skateurs sénégalais veulent briller aux JOJ à Dakar
signals.summary: Au Sénégal, une jeune génération de skateurs se prépare dans le but de participer aux Jeux olympiques de la jeunesse (JOJ), première compétition olympique sur le sol africain, qui se déroulera du 31 octobre au 13 novembre, à Dakar.

signals.summary: Esta segunda-feira, o Presidente de Cabo Verde, José Maria Neves, anunciou a recandidatura ao cargo nas eleições de 15 de Novembro. signals.title: Guinée : Doumbouya rencontre Ouattara en Côte d'Ivoire

signals.summary: Cela fait cinq ans que Mamadi Doumbouya est président de la Guinée. Il a passé le week-end en Côte d'Ivoire en visite officielle, où il s'est entretenu avec son homologue Alassane Ouattara. Au cœur des échanges : le renforcement de la coopération économique, commerciale et sécuritaire entre les deux pays voisins. Les précisions de Jean Barrere, correspondant France 24 à Abidjan.

signals.title: Guerre au Moyen-Orient : la Somalie cherche des itinéraires maritimes alternatifs

signals.title: Nairobi senator Edwin Sifuna emerges as a rising challenger to Kenya's President Ruto

signals.title: Présidentielle au Nigeria : la détention d’El-Rufai prive l’opposition de toute velléité de victoire
